caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet made up of a grey and white textured fabric with a subtle diamond pattern, decorated with black lace trimming around the edge. The left side of the bonnet features a detailed cluster of flowers including pink roses, purple-blue blossoms, red accents, and green leaves, with additional greenery and stems extending outward. The lower right side of the bonnet is adorned with a large, bright pink ribbon bow, which hangs down with trailing ends. The composition is centered on a light, unadorned background, highlighting the details and colors of the bonnet and decorations. The artist's signature, "Ruby M. Barnes," is visible in the lower right corner, and there are numerical notations in the lower left corner.
